newsitem.title: USA: Police seek motorists who grabbed spilled cash.
newsitem.headline: Police seek motorists who grabbed spilled cash.

text.p: Police were searching on Wednesday for several motorists who grabbed thousands of dollars in cash spilled from an armoured truck on an interstate highway during rush hour traffic late Tuesday.

One motorist may have sped off with as much $20,000, police said. The incident started when the driver of the truck reported hearing a "whooshing" sound as he drove down Interstate 75 in suburban Lincoln Park, Michigan.

The side door of the Wolverine Dispatch Inc. truck flew open and two bags of money, containing more than $200,000 each, fell out, Michigan State Police said. "Several individuals stopped to grab money for themselves, but a number of others stopped to help pick up the money for the armoured car company," Trooper John Sosa said.
Wolverine Dispatch, based in Comstock Park, Michigan, near Kalamazoo, declined comment on the incident.
